stemMd: Which country belonged to the original six signatories of the 1951 European Coal and Steel Community treaty?
explanationMd: The six signatories were Belgium, France, Germany, Italy, Luxembourg and the Netherlands. Luxembourg is therefore the only listed founding signatory. Present membership should not be confused with founding status.

distractorRationale.d: Spain was not among the six founding signatories.
distractorRationale.a: Sweden was not among these founders.
distractorRationale.b: Austria was not among the six.
